scope.task: Pose-driven supplied-track multi-person repetition counting without learner-side per-person count or period labels

candidate_mechanism: Estimate kinematic feasible sets from train-only bone-length and velocity feature statistics without evaluator labels.
Propagate observed joints and missing-coordinate sets through one frozen multiband analytic response bank.
Return a per-supplied-identity count set or interval, and return a point estimate only when that set is sufficiently narrow.
Require structural inclusion under nested missingness masks and audit width separately from point-count error.

core_claims.claim: A pose-missingness set can be propagated to a set of plausible repetition counts for each supplied identity without using per-person count or period labels in the learner.
core_claims.finding: No checked primary source directly discloses this exact input-to-output task. SSTRAC and Viewpoint-Invariant Exercise Repetition Counting repair or interpolate pose and emit point counts; PAMS emits a self-supervised point count; MultiCounter and MultiCounter+ emit supervised per-person point counts. The residual is therefore plausible but only task-specific.

core_claims.claim: Nested missingness masks should induce nested output count sets and nondecreasing uncertainty width.
core_claims.finding: The general nested-mask and missing-information uncertainty principle is occupied. Zaffran et al. explicitly define included masks, analyze variance, inter-quantile distance and interval-length isotonicity under assumptions, and construct CP-MDA-Nested variants. Exact output-set inclusion for this particular analytic RAC map could be a correctness property, but not a broad novelty claim.

core_claims.claim: Containment of the frozen full-observation point estimate by a masked-input interval establishes coverage.
core_claims.finding: False. Self-containment measures consistency with the method's own reference prediction and can preserve systematic count bias. Statistical coverage concerns the true count and requires labeled calibration or a proved set-membership model plus explicit assumptions. The proposed label-free gate cannot license conformal, calibrated, mask-conditional, or true-count coverage language.

core_claims.claim: The resulting count interval is a non-vacuous partial-identification region under pose missingness.
core_claims.finding: Unproven. A kinematic envelope estimated from empirical feature statistics is not automatically a valid set containing the latent pose, and an approximate lower/upper response mass is not automatically the sharp image of that set through the count operator. The safe term is sensitivity envelope or feasible-set count range unless soundness and, for partial identification, sharpness are established.

adjudication.score_label: moderate task-specific novelty, weak component novelty
adjudication.precise_delta: Given a supplied, possibly incomplete pose track for one identity, propagate one explicitly nested feasible coordinate set through one frozen analytic repetition-response map and return the corresponding discrete count range; then test whether that range stays informative as pose is removed, without fitting the learner to per-person count or period labels. The contribution, if it survives, is this task-specific propagation-and-non-vacuity result, not counting intervals, conformal prediction, nested masking, pose uncertainty, skeleton repair, robust RAC, self-supervised periodicity, or multi-person counting.
adjudication.brutal_summary: The direct conjunction was not found, but the candidate is currently a composition of established ideas with unresolved semantics. Its strongest advertised gate measures agreement with its own point counter, not truth. Without a sound feasible set and exact or certified propagation, the output is only a sensitivity envelope; without labeled calibration, it has no statistical coverage guarantee. This is enough for one tiny proof-and-vacuity gate, not enough for a method claim.

coverage_semantics.nested_mask_set_inclusion: A deterministic structural property. It can be proved or exhaustively checked for the implemented set map. It says nothing by itself about the true count.
coverage_semantics.full_observation_self_containment: An engineering sanity check: whether the masked interval contains the frozen full-input model estimate. It is not calibration and can preserve model bias.
coverage_semantics.empirical_true_count_coverage: A post-freeze evaluation statistic requiring evaluator-side real count labels. It does not become a finite-sample guarantee merely because the learner did not see those labels.
coverage_semantics.calibrated_coverage: Requires a labeled calibration sample, a declared calibration algorithm and assumptions such as exchangeability or a justified correction. This conflicts with the current no learner-side count-label story if calibration is part of the method.
coverage_semantics.set_membership_soundness: A conditional guarantee is possible only if the latent missing pose is assumed or shown to lie in the feasible set and the output range contains every count attainable by that set.
coverage_semantics.partial_identification: Allowed only with an explicit identified estimand, admissible-data model, proof of validity and, if sharpness is claimed, proof that every point in the region is attainable.

fatal_risks: The train-statistic kinematic set may not contain latent joints under occlusion, off-frame motion, detector failure or MNAR missingness.
Peak selection, thresholding and cycle rounding are nonlinear; interval arithmetic can under-approximate the attainable count set or explode into a vacuous range.
No learner-side real count labels means no conformal or empirical coverage calibration of the count endpoint.
A 95% full-estimate containment gate can pass while true-count coverage is arbitrarily bad.
The interval can be no tighter than a trivial [0, maximum feasible cycles] range at realistic missingness.
The work may read as an application of missing-covariate UQ plus SSTRAC-style robustness rather than a new signal-processing principle.
Per-track decomposition on supplied identities does not create a new MRAC contribution and depends on externally supervised detector, pose estimator and tracker quality.
Only random masks would not support claims about real occlusion or tracker-linked missingness.
allowed_claims: We study set-valued repetition counting under controlled missingness on supplied pose tracks.
The learner-side uncertainty-set constructor and analytic counter use no per-person count or period labels, if the implementation audit confirms this exactly.
Under the declared feasible-set and exact-propagation assumptions, nested input feasible sets induce nested output count sets.
After predictions are frozen, evaluator-side labels show an empirical true-count containment rate on the named validation split.
The returned sets were narrower than the preregistered trivial baseline at matched empirical containment on the audited mask families, if observed.
External detector, pose estimator and tracker supervision are disclosed explicitly.
forbidden_claims: first count interval, first uncertainty-aware counting, first missing-pose RAC, or any other first claim
state of the art or superior robustness without matched evidence
calibrated, conformal, valid, guaranteed or mask-conditionally covered count intervals without labeled calibration and proved assumptions
partial identification or sharp bounds without a formal admissible-set and sharpness argument
nested-mask monotonicity as a new general principle
robustness to real occlusion from random-mask self-containment alone
phase, local-window, dynamic-threshold, identity-consistency, self-supervised periodicity or MRAC novelty

minimum_next_gate.name: G0_SET_SEMANTICS_AND_NONVACUITY
minimum_next_gate.scope: Frozen local train/validation only; no server, test, sealed, heldout or result access; no training and no threshold tuning after inspection.
precommit: Freeze one analytic response bank, one missing-coordinate feasible-set rule, one count-set definition, one trivial count-set baseline and deterministic nested mask chains.
State whether the output is an exact attainable count set, a certified outer bound or only a sensitivity envelope.
Separate learner-side label access, evaluator-side post-freeze scoring and any calibration data.
checks: On short enumeratable pose fragments, compare the computed output set with exhaustive feasible completions; kill on any under-coverage of the exact attainable set.
Across every audited nested mask pair, require exact set inclusion and nondecreasing width; kill on the first violation.
Retain the original sanity target of at least 95% containment of the frozen full-observation estimate, but label it self-containment only.
At 30% missing joints, kill if median width exceeds 1.5 cycles or if the method is not tighter than the preregistered trivial range at matched self-containment.

After all predictions are locked, allow an evaluator-only validation pass against true counts. Report empirical coverage with uncertainty; kill the coverage story if the predeclared target is missed, and never upgrade it to a guarantee.
Run at least random-joint, contiguous-frame, limb-block and confidence-correlated mask families; restrict conclusions to the families that pass.
minimum_next_gate.decision: Only a zero-violation soundness/nesting result plus non-vacuous width and honest evaluator-side truth containment justifies a later bounded implementation proposal. Otherwise abandon the candidate or relabel it as a diagnostic sensitivity baseline.
